name: Madame Zircon Dotsworth
description: Sacred geometry built from a hundred thousand dots. She claims to have counted every one of them.

designs.title: Lotus Mandala
designs.description: Rings of stippled petals opening from a black centre. A classic for the back of the hand or the sternum.

designs.title: Sun Wheel
designs.description: A dot-shaded disc with a wheel of triangles at its heart and rays like black blades.

designs.title: Flower of Life
designs.description: The old six-petal lattice, darkening in dots towards its rim, inside a ring of thorns.

designs.title: Nested Triangles
designs.description: Interlocked triangles descending to one black point, every band shaded with stipple.

designs.title: Moon Mandala
designs.description: A stippled moon circled by every phase and eight small stars. For night owls.

designs.title: Stippled Orb
designs.description: A dot-shaded sphere bound in three crossing orbits, with scattered stars around it.
